title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #15

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does it mean to say that God is the sole Creator? (1 mark)
   A. God had many helpers in creation
   B. God was made by someone
   C. God is the only Creator
   D. God made only the animals

2. Which is an example of a good thought? (1 mark)
   A. I will help my mother with the dishes
   B. I will not greet anyone
   C. I will take my friend's book
   D. I hope she falls

3. What does Ephesians 4:26 teach about anger? (1 mark)
   A. Keep anger for a week
   B. Never feel angry
   C. Do not sin in your anger and do not stay angry for long
   D. Always hit back

4. A friend invites you to skip class and play. What is the best choice? (1 mark)
   A. Tell the teacher a lie
   B. Politely say no and go to class
   C. Leave school
   D. Join him secretly

5. What brings harmony in a family? (1 mark)
   A. Jealousy
   B. Fighting
   C. Selfishness
   D. Respect and love among members

6. Who is included in the nuclear family? (1 mark)
   A. Cousins and aunts only
   B. Only grandparents
   C. Neighbours
   D. Parents and their children

7. Who opened the donkey's mouth? (1 mark)
   A. The Lord
   B. Balak
   C. The angel of the king
   D. Balaam

8. Which verse says that the fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge? (1 mark)
   A. Proverbs 1:7
   B. Luke 1:37
   C. Acts 2:38
   D. John 3:16

9. What lesson can we learn from Joseph's plan? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore the future
   B. Take all the food
   C. Spend everything
   D. Plan and save for hard times

10. How old was Abram when God changed his name? (1 mark)
   A. 99
   B. 120
   C. 50
   D. 75

11. How old was Abram when he left Haran? (1 mark)
   A. 100
   B. 50
   C. 75
   D. 25

12. Who was John the Baptist's mother? (1 mark)
   A. Sarah
   B. Anna
   C. Elizabeth
   D. Mary

13. What does "forerunner" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A king
   B. One who goes before to prepare
   C. One who follows behind
   D. A teacher of maths

14. Which Gospel records the healing of Bartimaeus? (1 mark)
   A. Acts
   B. Romans
   C. Genesis
   D. Mark

15. Which quality did Bartimaeus show when he kept shouting to Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Faith and persistence
   C. Laziness
   D. Anger

16. Which is a way of thanking God? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring Him
   B. Being rude
   C. Praying and singing praise
   D. Complaining

17. In which town did Jesus raise the widow's son? (1 mark)
   A. Jericho
   B. Cana
   C. Nain
   D. Nazareth

18. What does the miracle show about Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. He is a king of Rome
   B. He has power over death
   C. He is only a teacher
   D. He is a weak man

19. Which verse tells us to give to the one who asks? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 1:1
   B. John 3:16
   C. Acts 2:38
   D. Matthew 5:42

20. Where is the parable of the lost coin found? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 15:8-10
   B. Genesis 12:1
   C. Acts 2:38
   D. John 3:16

21. What causes joy among the angels of God, according to Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. A rich person giving
   B. One sinner who repents
   C. A new building
   D. A large crowd

22. What does "evangelise" mean? (1 mark)
   A. To plant seeds
   B. To cook
   C. To build
   D. To tell others the good news about Jesus

23. Who is a stranger? (1 mark)
   A. Your cousin
   B. Your grandmother
   C. Your teacher
   D. Someone you do not know

24. Which is a benefit of obeying parents? (1 mark)
   A. Peace at home
   B. Trouble
   C. Poor marks
   D. Lost trust

25. Which is a school rule? (1 mark)
   A. Skip lessons
   B. Fight freely
   C. Arrive on time
   D. Litter

26. Is love only a feeling? (1 mark)
   A. Only for adults
   B. Yes
   C. Only in church
   D. No, it is also a choice and action

27. Which behaviour shows respect for the church? (1 mark)
   A. Running
   B. Shouting
   C. Entering quietly
   D. Littering

28. Who taught the disciples the Lord's Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Moses
   B. Jesus
   C. Peter
   D. John

29. Which action shows self-control? (1 mark)
   A. Shouting
   B. Taking others' things
   C. Pushing in a queue
   D. Waiting for your turn

30. Which verse compares a person without self-control to a broken city wall? (1 mark)
   A. Acts 2:38
   B. Proverbs 25:28
   C. John 3:16
   D. Proverbs 1:7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. State two ways of coping with anger. (2 marks)

32. Name two fruits of the Holy Spirit listed in Galatians 5:22-23. (2 marks)

33. Explain why a child should never blame themselves if they were touched wrongly, and say what they should do. (5 marks)

34. Describe how Zacchaeus met Jesus and how his behaviour changed. (4 marks)

35. Give three ways of showing respect to family members. (3 marks)

36. Explain how Luke 16:10 and Genesis 2:15 teach responsibility, and give examples from school and home. (5 marks)

37. State three qualities of good giving. (3 marks)

38. Explain what the story of Samson teaches and what it does not teach children to do. (5 marks)

39. Give three ways of avoiding situations that lead to sin. (3 marks)

40. Explain why we should thank God for making us. (3 marks)

41. Describe the naming of John. (4 marks)

42. State two ways of glorifying God with our bodies. (2 marks)

43. Describe how Jesus responded when Bartimaeus called for mercy. (3 marks)

44. What is a mustard seed like, and what does it grow into? (2 marks)

45. State two lessons from the parable of the lost coin. (2 marks)

46. Name two things that Zacchaeus promised to do after meeting Jesus. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — God is the only Creator
   Sole means only. God alone made everything.

2. A — I will help my mother with the dishes
   Helping at home is a thought that leads to kindness.

3. C — Do not sin in your anger and do not stay angry for long
   The verse says that we should not sin when angry and should settle it quickly.

4. B — Politely say no and go to class
   Skipping class is wrong and harms learning.

5. D — Respect and love among members
   Respect and love make a home peaceful.

6. D — Parents and their children
   The nuclear family is the small group of parents and children living together.

7. A — The Lord
   The Lord made the donkey speak.

8. A — Proverbs 1:7
   Proverbs 1:7 says this.

9. D — Plan and save for hard times
   Joseph advised saving in good years.

10. A — 99
   Genesis 17:1 says he was ninety-nine.

11. C — 75
   Genesis 12:4 says he was seventy-five.

12. C — Elizabeth
   Elizabeth was Zechariah's wife.

13. B — One who goes before to prepare
   A forerunner goes ahead.

14. D — Mark
   Mark 10:46-52 tells the story.

15. B — Faith and persistence
   He believed that Jesus could help him.

16. C — Praying and singing praise
   Praise and prayer express thanks.

17. C — Nain
   Luke 7:11 says Nain.

18. B — He has power over death
   Jesus is Lord of life.

19. D — Matthew 5:42
   Matthew 5:42 says to give to the one who asks.

20. A — Luke 15:8-10
   The parable is in Luke 15:8-10.

21. B — One sinner who repents
   Luke 15:10 says this.

22. D — To tell others the good news about Jesus
   Evangelising means sharing the gospel.

23. D — Someone you do not know
   A stranger is someone you do not know.

24. A — Peace at home
   Obedience brings harmony.

25. C — Arrive on time
   Being on time is a common school rule.

26. D — No, it is also a choice and action
   Love is shown in actions.

27. C — Entering quietly
   Quiet respect honours God's house.

28. B — Jesus
   Jesus taught it when asked.

29. D — Waiting for your turn
   Waiting is self-control.

30. B — Proverbs 25:28
   Proverbs 25:28.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: Breathe deeply, count to ten, walk away, talk to a trusted adult, pray. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: Any two of love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct fruit.

33. (5 marks)
   Answer: The person who did wrong is always guilty. A child cannot control an adult or older person who chooses to do wrong. The child should tell a trusted adult, who will believe and protect them, and can call 116 for help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the person doing wrong being guilty, 1 for the child not being to blame, 1 for telling a trusted adult, 1 for the helper protecting, 1 for the helpline.

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: Zacchaeus climbed a tree to see Jesus. Jesus called him by name and went to his house. Zacchaeus promised to give half his goods to the poor and to repay four times anyone he had cheated.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for climbing the tree, 1 for Jesus calling him, 1 for giving to the poor, 1 for repaying.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: Greet politely, obey, help with chores, speak kindly, share, pray for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 3.

36. (5 marks)
   Answer: Luke 16:10 says being faithful in small things leads to bigger tasks. Genesis 2:15 says God gave people work to do and things to care for. At school a child covers books and cleans the class. At home a child washes plates and looks after younger siblings.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verse meaning, 1 for a school example, 1 for a home example, 1 for a clear link.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Cheerful, quiet, respectful, useful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid quality.

38. (5 marks)
   Answer: It teaches that God is powerful, that strength and abilities are gifts from God, and that we should trust Him and be honest with parents. It does not teach children to fight lions or dangerous animals or to do dangerous things. Children should stay away from danger and call adults.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's power, 1 for gifts from God, 1 for trust and honesty, 1 for not fighting dangerous animals, 1 for staying safe.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Choose good friends, avoid wrong places, be careful about what you watch, keep busy with good things, pray.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: God created us in His image and planned each of us. He gave us life, family and talents. Thanking Him shows that we value His gifts.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God creating us, 1 for the gifts of life or talents, 1 for the link to giving thanks.

41. (4 marks)
   Answer: On the eighth day people wanted to call him Zechariah. Elizabeth said his name is John. They asked Zechariah, who wrote, "His name is John." His speech returned and he praised God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keep clean and healthy, speak kindly, avoid harmful things, use hands to help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus stopped and said, "Call him." He asked what he wanted, then healed him and told him that his faith had healed him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for stopping, 1 for asking, 1 for healing.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: A very small seed that grows into a large tree.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Every person is precious to God; God searches for the lost; heaven rejoices when someone repents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Give half his possessions to the poor and pay back four times to anyone he cheated.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each promise.
